purpose: Project lead's rulings on contribution-screen calls. Applied on load by scripts/rederive_screen.py so the screener's spreadsheets stay untouched and every override is attributable.

boundary_ruling.question: Does benign long-context degradation, measured by needle or distractor probes with no attacker present, count as in scope?
boundary_ruling.consequence: Papers removed on the grounds that they study long-context behaviour without an adversary are readmitted. Papers removed on subject matter (robot manipulation, GUI agents, multi-agent planning) stay removed. Applied to the whole set on 2026-10-16: five papers readmitted, one (Odysseys) removed, so a single test governs every call.

keep_despite_screen.why: holds the corpus's only 'position exhaustion' mechanism entry; NIAH retrieval collapses 100 -> 2.0% past the trained range
evaluates MK-NIAH/RULER, LongHealth, BABILong to 10M tokens; the screen's note that it never claims a context-degradation failure mode is factually wrong
evaluated on BABILong distractors and HELMET RAG; extends usable context 32K -> 128K

keep_despite_screen.title_contains: Beyond Needle(s) in the Embodied Haystack
keep_despite_screen.why: context-length x needle-depth heatmap, the canonical lost-in-the-middle plot; readmitted under the same ruling on 2026-10-16

8K-128K x 6 needle depths; masking the top-5% retrieval heads collapses MMLongBench-Doc accuracy 48.2 -> 5.7% while random masking does not. A mechanistic account of why evidence in a long window is missed, and the only corpus paper that names the component responsible

remove_despite_screen.why: the screen kept it on a genre-precedent test (WebArena-style harnesses belong). Under the lead's ruling the test is whether the paper measures content already in the window being mishandled, and this measures task success and trajectory efficiency only, with no untrusted content and nothing position-dependent. Removed on 2026-10-16 so one test is applied to the whole set.

contribution_coded_by_lead_session.why: The screen stopped at out_of_scope on these five and never coded what they contribute. After the lead's boundary ruling readmitted them the field was left blank rather than guessed. Coded here from each paper's own key_result and its existing registry entry, so the value is traceable to evidence rather than asserted.

codes.evidence: holds both `position exhaustion` (mechanism, the corpus's only entry) and `P-RoPE / MiniWin` (defense, validated_against incidental). The method is the headline contribution; the mechanism is its diagnosis.
holds `Sleep paradigm (Memory Consolidation + Dreaming)`, validated_against incidental; key_result reports it outperforming baselines across five task families
holds `L2A (Learning To Attend)`, validated_against incidental; key_result is performance within 3% of full attention from 8K to 128K

codes.title_contains: Beyond Needle(s) in the Embodied Haystack
codes.evidence: contributes the NiEH/NsiEH benchmark; key_result is a measurement, LLaVA-OV at 0.0% accuracy past 1M tokens, not a proposed method

identifies multimodal retrieval heads as the component responsible: 4.4-10.2% of heads carry 50% of retrieval-score mass, and masking the top 5% collapses accuracy 48.2 -> 5.7 while random masking does not. A named incidental mechanism, and per the audit the only corpus paper naming the component responsible for lost-in-the-middle.
codes.note: has no registry entry yet; qualifies for one as an incidental mechanism
codes.technique_name: multimodal retrieval heads (sparse heads carrying retrieval)
